Required subjects (e.g. Maths, Physics) must be met with that subject at AP level or IB HL; SAT/ACT cannot satisfy subject requirements. No separate rule for Calculus AB vs BC published.
ap.note: Course pages do not list AP; rules from the University's US entry equivalencies

50770.tests: SAT/ACT not required; can count towards grade equivalence for US applicants (replaces one AP/Honors course) but cannot meet subject requirements
50770.a_level: A*AA including A in Maths and Physics
50770.turkish_route: Lise Diploması alone is not clearly enough for direct entry; direct entry needs A-level-equivalent grades (e.g. recognised foundation programme, at least one year of university in Turkey, or IB/A-level). Engineering/Physics/Maths Foundation Year: Lise Diploması with at least 80% overall and at least 80% in maths and physics.
50770.prerequisite_maths: A-level/IB HL Maths and Physics; GCSE English and Maths grade 4; Engineering/Physics/Maths Foundation Year for applicants without the required subjects
